repos_data.description: Build agent that uses 80% less token and delivers better results.

mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
Turn tracker tickets into autonomous agent sessions
An LLM-powered, autonomous coding assistant. Also offers an MCP and ACP mode.
A keyboard-first menubar app to monitor and jump between AI coding sessions — minimum setup required.
A context-aware terminal-based coding agent written in Go. Supports multiple-providers, MCPs, Subagents, Agent Skills, controllable tool output retention, hashline edits, and more.
YYLO (why-lo): AI coding-agent orchestration CLI with equivalent yylo and yy launchers.

See what your coding agent actually did. A desktop pal and notch for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and any agent: test results read from the output, faked passes caught, and an MCP server any AI tool can ask. New: talk to Blu, who sees your screen, draws on it as it explains and uses your apps.
Your personal AI, 100% in your control. Born in the Mac notch — now beyond it.
A new kind of IDE for agentic engineering
Free, open-source Mac app for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity. Your AI coding agent with a real browser, iOS Simulator, parallel chats on git worktrees, and an iPhone app. No API key.
Talk to your shell — commands run, questions go to AI. No prefixes.
An MCP server for safer coding agents: skill routing, C4 workflow gates, memory checks, and verification before completion.
VS Code × Codex × Jira, in one free, open-source Mac app. Repository browsing, Kanban tasks, subagent inspection and local code review. Public beta, macOS 15+.
Open-source desktop coding agent for macOS. Use any model: local with Ollama, your own API keys or a ChatGPT sign-in. Parallel chats, MCP connectors, skills, and computer use on a desktop of its own.

Free, 100% local MCP server. Turns your codebase into an AST knowledge graph so AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) get exact caller trees, semantic search, and safe writes — 60% fewer tokens, zero data egress.
Local-first shared memory and task coordination for AI coding agents. One Go binary, MCP server, markdown files you own. Hooks for Claude Code and Codex CLI (and their desktop apps).

macOS desk pet for DeepSeek Harness: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by your agent, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a whole skin. System Python, zero dependencies.

Triage for AI-generated code review: grades each changed diff line green/yellow/orange by impact, so reviewers spend attention where it matters. High-signal, low-noise (0 false blocks), deterministic — in your coding agent (MCP), editor (VS Code), and CLI/CI.
Autonomous native crash debugging for Qwen Code via DAP → MCP. CodeLLDB, crash dumps, runtime evidence and agentic verification.
PR Genius — 提交前改进顾问 + 大型开源项目 PR 知识库

A sub-harness (both an MCP server and an MCP client). Delegates documentation and source code analysis, as well as interactions with related context-providing MCP servers, to a local or inexpensive OpenAI-compatible LLM. Drastically reduces token usage and context size for coding agents on the top-tier LLM.
Self-hosted AI coding agents that live in Slack — run Claude Code or Codex in your own infra, ship PRs, and keep every credential behind a controlled MCP tool layer.
Native iPhone and Mac clients for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, and Pi — reply on the go or work across split-pane chat and terminal views on Mac.
MCP server for VibeKit — build, deploy, and manage hosted apps and chat with their AI agents from Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
Read-only MCP server for GaussDB, built for coding agents.
Rollback and safety for AI coding agents and vibe coders: flag risky changes and restore project files, including uncommitted work, to their pre-session state.
MCP server: drive Swebsy Studio from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP agent — build real websites with the coding agent you already pay for, no per-token billing.
